report.summary: About 8% of UPI payments for okbank users began failing at 14:07 due to an incorrect routing configuration update (chg-9824) at 14:06 that directed okbank handles to an invalid /v3/collect endpoint on partner-bank-api instead of /v2/collect.

supporting.note: Routing table config update at 14:06 changed @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect
Error rate spiked starting at 14:07:00, coinciding with the config change
partner-bank-api returned 404 Not Found for /v3/collect starting at 14:07:03
payments-api logged upi-gateway error U30 (route failure) starting at 14:07:07
payments-api v2.15.0 was deployed at 14:05, just before incident onset

contradicting.note: Errors originate from upi-gateway failing to reach partner-bank-api at /v3/collect rather than internal code exceptions
Error messages explicitly cite upi-gateway error U30 (route failure)

facts.text: Error rates for payments-api and upi-gateway spiked starting at 2026-10-07T14:07:00Z.
upi-gateway routing configuration was updated at 2026-10-07T14:06:00Z to route @okbank handles to /v3/collect.
partner-bank-api returned 404 Not Found for /v3/collect requests starting at 14:07:03Z.
payments-api encountered upi-gateway error U30 route failure starting at 14:07:07Z.

assumptions: partner-bank-api does not support the /v3/collect endpoint for okbank handles.
evidence_gaps: Direct access logs from partner-bank-api to verify endpoint availability.

timeline.event: upi-gateway routing config updated for okbank handles
Error rate anomaly begins on payments-api and upi-gateway
payments-api logs upi-gateway error U30 (route failure)

recommended_actions.action: Roll back the routing configuration change to restore @okbank handles to /v2/collect.
recommended_actions.rationale: Will immediately resolve the 404 errors and U30 route failures causing payment drops.

recommended_actions.action: Implement validation checks for partner API endpoints prior to applying gateway routing changes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents deploying configuration routes to non-existent or unsupported third-party endpoints.
